title.narrative: Heifer International Dairy sector funding project

description.narrative: Embassy of Ireland in Kenya supports Heifer International to implement the Catalytic Impact for Dairy Sector Growth Project. Project Goal: To accelerate pathway to living income through creation of job opportunities amongst 25,000 households through catalyzing the growth of farmer cooperatives and youth agribusinesses. Outcomes: • Improved competitiveness, and increased incomes of ten (10) farmer owned agribusiness, through catalytic fund investment • 10 Farmer Owned Agri Businesses (FOAB) organized into viable enterprises for enhanced market access and service delivery.• Increased Producer organization profitability through catalytic fund investment• Increased participation of Women and youth as a result of investments along the dairy value chainsObjectives: • To strengthen the institutional capacities of 10 farmer owned dairy agribusiness to sustainably manage catalytic impact investments.• To improve the competitiveness of ten (10) farmer owned agribusinesses through market and business development, financial and technical capacity investment for impact.• To stimulate the growth of women and youth owned enterprises for improved household livelihoods.
